questions.markdown: Design a 4-bit parallel adder with carry look ahead adder.
Design a full adder combinational circuit using decoder.
Convert the Jk flip flop to D Flip flop with necessary steps.
Design a sequence detector to detect three or more consecutive 1's in a sequence of bits using Mealy model
What is the role of the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) in a CPU, and how does it perform arithmetic and logical operations?
Design a 4-bit by 3-bit binary multiplier and explain its operation.
Design a code converter using NAND gates only to convert a decimal digit represented in 8 4 2 1 code to a decimal digit represented in Gray code.
Design a multiplexer with a 16-to-1 configuration by using 2-to-1 multiplexers only. Illustrate the block diagram and truth table for this multiplexer design.
Design an Asynchronous DOWN counter to count from 6 to 2 continuously using negative edge triggered T-flip flops and minimum external gates.
Multiply $(-7)_{10}$ with $(3)_{10}$ by using Booth's multiplication algorithm. Give the flow chart of the multiplication.
Design a sequence generator using synchronous counter with states $0\to3\to2\to1\to0$ that generates the sequence '1100'. Use T Flip-Flop and minimum external gates.
All four flip-flops' inputs are made high in the figure below. Draw the transition diagram and find the signal's frequency at the output $Y$.
